reviews.title: Awesome! :D
reviews.contents: Would be nice to have a kind of "reminder" notification daily to make sure I don't forget my work out... Moms are busy people

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.contents: I neglected to read the fine print and this app auto-renewed. Despite having all of my usage info (I did perhaps 2 videos in 3 months) when I emailed asking for a refund after auto renew I was reminded to read the fine print. Program seems good! Customer service terrible.

reviews.title: Free trial?
reviews.contents: So many workout apps out there- and so many just don’t work for me. Would be great if you could offer a trail period to see what your workouts are actually like! 🙏🏼

reviews.title: Useless and expensive
reviews.contents: Exercises don’t work. Requests a refunded and got an automated response immediately citing policy. Not worth your time or money. Incredibly disappointing

reviews.title: Charged before trial ended
reviews.contents: I was expecting a 7 day free trial (clearly described when I signed up) but was charged the same day I signed up. It’s unfortunate because I don’t like the app, specifically how they schedule the workouts, and I would not have signed up to continue beyond the trial. Worse yet, the only support I’ve received is from an AI chat bot.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.contents: It’s very well structured, you can easily see that they put effort into covering all the knowledge postpartum moms need to know in a way that is easy to access and to learn.

reviews.title: Need more size diversity
reviews.contents: I do wish there were more models of all shapes and sizes demonstrating the exercises. Sometimes it’s hard to tell if I’m doing things right because my larger abdomen does move the same way as a flat abdomen does.

reviews.title: Working For Me
reviews.contents: The daily workouts are 20-40 minutes and they change each day - arms, maybe, then lower body, then core, then yoga… I feel like I’m able to stick with this because it’s not too much to expect of someone to build a new habit. The moves are working on several parts at once, which helps to make sure you get a good workout in the shortest amount of time. I’ve been able to stick to my new routine for over a month now and I feel energized and strong after doing it each day. I like that the moves are all safe for my core so I don’t have to think about it. I saw someone mentioned that they wished for a reminder - they have done that! It reminds me every day.

reviews.title: Good program but didn’t work for me
reviews.contents:
I liked the workouts and finished the program. Unfortunately I didn’t see any changes. I know progress is slow, but I wish I saw something more. 
The app is good and the workouts are well made. 
I wish the community was more active. And I wish they had a monthly plan instead of annual so I could have tried it for a while.

reviews.title: Unnecessary equipment
reviews.contents:
I was surprised (and disappointed) to see that they require obscure exercise equipment like a pedal puller resistance band (according to Google I literally didn’t even know what it was called) for their workouts. The last thing a new mom needs is more stuff. You could have just used weights or something. 

I would urge you to swap out your program for more inclusive workouts that don’t need a bunch of equipment.
